name: Explore Architecture (formerly Inside Design)
what_you_do: A week of hands-on design work. You build models, draw plans, scan and print in 3D, and hear talks. It ends with a show of your work. Choose Blacksburg, online, or a day camp in Alexandria, VA.
who_can_apply: Everyone in grades 9 to 12. No prior design courses needed.
pay_detail: Blacksburg sessions $1,250 each. Virtual camp $250. WAAC day camp in Alexandria $600. Campers buy their own materials.
duration: One week. Blacksburg June 20 to 26 or Aug 1 to 7. Online July 12 to 16. Alexandria June 28 to July 2. The page gives no year.
deadline_text: Registration opens Nov 15, 2026. The close date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Register on the camp page once registration opens. No refunds after May 15. Questions: explore-architecture@vt.edu or 540-231-5383.
notes: The page lists camp days but no year, so confirm them. It no longer lists grades, housing or scholarships, so ask the program. The material list is coming soon.
